summary.en: The first feature release adds bilingual administration, richer media notifications, reliable delivery, and independent update feeds
summary.zh-CN: 首个功能正式版带来双语管理界面、更丰富的媒体推送、可靠投递和独立更新源

text.en: Added complete English and Chinese interface support with browser-language detection, persistent manual preferences, and localized navigation, forms, validation, logs, and media presentation.
text.zh-CN: 新增完整的中英文界面支持，包括浏览器语言识别、持久化手动偏好，以及导航、表单、校验、日志和媒体展示的多语言适配。

text.en: Added channel-aware plain-text and Markdown rendering, deterministic delivery snapshots, and DingTalk media images while keeping each channel's protocol isolated.
text.zh-CN: 新增渠道感知的普通文本与 Markdown 渲染、确定性投递快照和钉钉媒体图片，同时保持各渠道协议相互隔离。

text.en: Webhook media presentation is now generated on demand, Jellyfin and Emby metadata refreshes safely, Jellyfin 10.10 API-key queries and artwork fallbacks work correctly, and notification delivery no longer requires a public base URL.
text.zh-CN: Webhook 媒体展示现改为按需生成，Jellyfin 与 Emby 元数据可安全刷新，并修复 Jellyfin 10.10 API Key 查询及图片回退；推送也不再强制要求配置对外访问地址。

text.en: DingTalk deliveries now share a persistent sending window by robot token, honor official 410100 cooldowns, retry transient system-busy responses with bounded backoff, and expose localized throttle status without leaking credentials.
text.zh-CN: 钉钉推送现按机器人 Token 共享持久化发送窗口，遵循官方 410100 冷却规则，对临时系统繁忙采用有上限的退避重试，并以双语展示限流状态且不泄露凭据。

text.en: Added independently tracked Beta and Release update checks, cumulative bilingual release notes, embedded build metadata, and fixed Cloudflare Pages feeds that avoid GitHub API rate limits.
text.zh-CN: 新增相互独立的 Beta 与 Release 更新检查、累计双语更新记录、内嵌构建元数据，以及不受 GitHub API 限流影响的 Cloudflare Pages 固定更新源。

en: Deploy the immutable v0.1.0 image and restart the container.
Database tables and delivery snapshot, rate-limit, and observability fields are migrated automatically at startup; no manual database step is required.
No new required configuration is introduced. Configure the public base URL only when no-sign-in notification detail links are desired.
zh-CN: 部署不可变镜像 v0.1.0 并重启容器。
数据库表以及投递快照、限流和可观测性字段会在启动时自动迁移，无需手动操作数据库。
本次没有新增必填配置；仅在需要推送中的免登录详情链接时配置对外访问地址。
